_about: Voiceover voice picks. Fish Audio entries are official Fish voices for the bundled Fish Audio MCP (text_to_speech voice_id). ElevenLabs entries use public voice-library IDs. Doubao entries are Volcano Engine speakers (Chinese/Japanese).

sarah.label: Sarah
sarah.description: Soft, sincere young female narrator. Explainers, tutorials, calm social videos.

ethan.label: Ethan
ethan.description: Clear, calm, authoritative male narrator. Educational and documentary explainers.

adrian.label: Adrian
adrian.description: Deep, slow, dramatic male storyteller. Trailers, stories, cinematic intros.

selene.label: Selene
selene.description: Calm, intimate female voice. Meditative, wellness and slow-paced content.

amelia.label: Amelia
amelia.description: Best for clear story reads, podcast intros, reels, and ads that need enthusiastic delivery. English-source accent: British.

brittney.label: Brittney
brittney.description: Best for creator videos, celebrity/news recaps, hot-topic commentary, and how-to clips with a lively presenter feel. English-source accent: American.

hope.label: Hope
hope.description: Best for crisp short-form narration, quick explainers, and social reads where clarity matters more than drama. English-source accent: American.

jessica.label: Jessica
jessica.description: Best when a VO needs to feel composed and direct: narration, story reads, and confident product copy. English-source accent: American.

arabella.label: Arabella
arabella.description: Best for fantasy, romance, wellness, and atmospheric stories that need mystery and feeling. English-source accent: American.

jane.label: Jane
jane.description: Best for long-form book pacing, classic narration, and steady story delivery. English-source accent: British.

maria.label: Maria
maria.description: Best for grandmother-style narration, gentle mature characters, and calm reflective story delivery. English-source accent: American.

mark.label: Mark
mark.description: Best for dialogue, assistant-style replies, and informal scripts where back-and-forth flow matters more than announcer polish. English-source accent: American.

frederick.label: Frederick
frederick.description: Best for history, science, mystery, and factual films that need a measured, well-spoken read. English-source accent: British.

peter.label: Peter
peter.description: Best for trustworthy narration, explainers, and brand reads where reliability matters more than theatrical delivery. English-source accent: American.

james.label: James
james.description: Best for controlled, direct reads with a heavier texture: audiobooks, story narration, and professional voiceover. English-source accent: American.

jon.label: Jon
jon.description: Best for clear messaging, commercials, and narration where the speaker should feel anchored and trustworthy. English-source accent: American.

sully.label: Sully
sully.description: Best for deep elderly narration, reflective storytelling, and warm authoritative reads with a seasoned feel. English-source accent: American.

david.label: David
david.description: Best for deep old-male story narration, classic audiobook passages, and grounded dramatic reads. English-source accent: British.

alex.label: Alex
alex.description: Best for YouTube, shorts, and entertainment clips that need pleasant presenter energy without sounding formal. English-source accent: American.
